name: oberthci
description: Oberth CI for Claude Code: the MCP server of your own Oberth installation and the agent loop skill.

plugins.name: oberth
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to your Oberth CI server over MCP (URL and token asked once, the token kept in Claude Code's credential store), trust its CA by an explicit SHA-256 pin with /oberth:connect, and follow the agent loop: one events_wait kept open, holds serviced within their TTL, assisted runs never taken as evidence.
